thread:
sam: quick ask — can we spike an APAC-edge spot pool for a demo next Tue, need ~6 H100s for ~4h window (12:00-16:00 UTC).
lee: which APAC region are we targeting? ap-southeast1 or ap-northeast1?
sam: ap-southeast1 preferred. vendor mentioned soft pool but quota might block. cc @procurement-bot
procurement-bot: Reservation request logged: PR-4021 (notes: demo spike). Vendor ack ETA 48h.
maya: we should check project quotas first. i can run a non-destructive probe to list available accelerators.
lee: last time quota killed us. sam — what's the project id?
sam: project=redwood-demo-apac, i'll DM the id / owners.
jia: FYI if we create a temporary burst pool we need billing tag = demo-apac and RBAC entries; will add to the PR.
sam: also want a fallback plan if spot eviction >30%.
alex: fallback idea: degrade to quantized Llama2-chat on A10s in eu-west1 via cross-region routing — lower perf, demo still shows end-to-end flow.
maya: i can run a capacity probe script to check soft availability windows. probe plan: check H100 count across asia-southeast1 zones without creating instances.
lee: please do dry-checks only. avoid accidental instance creation.
oncall: current quota in redwood-demo-apac: H100=4, A100=8, A10=12. quota increase required for >4 H100. file a GCP quota request.
sam: filing now, pinging cloud vendor contact and procurement.
procurement-bot: Ticket submitted: GCP-QINC-789 (target SLA 72h).
maya: running non-destructive describe probe now, will post results.
jia: double-check egress/bandwidth budgets for demo — we had unexpected charges last run.
lee: can we also reserve 2x A10s in eu-west1 as fallback? latency wise okay for a demo.
sam: yes add that to PR-4021.
jia: assigning @lee to RBAC + tags, @maya to run probe.
lee: ack.
maya: ack, probe starting — will report within 10m.
(10m later)
maya: probe results: asia-southeast1 H100 available count=0 (soft pool reported), A10 available=8. vendor states 7 H100 in satellite pool but requires contract amendment to release.
sam: ouch. procurement any ETA on amendment?
procurement-bot: Vendor response: contract amendment required; vendor ETA 5 business days to finalize.
jia: demo is Tue (3 business days). we should shift plan: option A: 4x A10 apac + route 2x H100 from vendor burst (if they can deliver sooner) OR option B: move demo to eu-west1 with full H100s.
lee: lean A (A10s in APAC + 2 H100 in EU) to preserve APAC latency for most interactions and show H100 path.
sam: agree. i'll update PR to request 4 A10 apac + 2 H100 eu as fallback mixture.
maya: updated probe run after PR tweak: A10s are available in apac, and eu-west1 shows 3 H100 available in quota.
alex: set capacity alert: capacity.demo-apac < 4 -> page the demo channel and oncall. Also ensure billing tag applied.
oncall: created PagerDuty schedule for demo window and added capacity alert rule.
sam: thanks — i've updated PR-4021 to request: 4x A10 apac (immediate), 2x H100 eu (fallback), billing_tag=demo-apac, RBAC entries = demo-viewers. Procurement + vendor contacts added.
lee: quick config snippet for the probe (dry-run):
```
# dry probe to list accelerator types per zone
for zone in asia-southeast1-a asia-southeast1-b; do
  gcloud compute accelerator-types describe nvidia-h100 --zone=$zone --project=redwood-demo-apac || true
done
```
lee: do not run create commands here.
maya: ran the describe probe; results above. vendor confirmed real H100s are behind contract.
sam: plan updated — demo will use A10s in APAC + shallow H100 path in EU. notifying product.
jia: i'll update runbook and cost estimate. expect ~30% lower perf but demo latency should be acceptable.
alex: add alert: `capacity.demo-apac` and tag `demo-apac` to billing.
oncall: closing loop: PR-4021 updated, GCP-QINC-789 open, vendor contract pending 5bd.
sam: great work, thanks everyone :thumbsup: i'll close thread once PR merges.
lee: thx all
